registered: before the judged run; the predictions were frozen first (01117a1)
stability: the engine's dense classification must equal the sign of the reference spectrum's leading growth rate (stable or unstable)
rationale: Engine and reference implement the same declared laws; both solve the stationary equations to about 1e-10 in their units, so these bounds test modelling equivalence with a wide margin over solver precision, not rounding. Stationary states need no time step, so no dt term enters. Whether a heredity disc renews is not an acceptance item.
